title: Thousands feared dead in Venezuela earthquakes
summary: Thousands of Venezuelans were feared dead on Thursday after two powerful earthquakes wreaked havoc in and around the capital Caracas, with the U.S. Geological Survey, using predictive modeling to estimate the death toll, said it could exceed 10,000.
